parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of solid wood, providing rigidity and shape.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts including the base, drawers, countertop, and shelves, ensuring stability and durability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds the entire structure together.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the lower supporting section of the cabinet, typically including legs or a plinth.
parts.Functional_description: It provides elevation and stability to the cabinet, distributing weight evenly to the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that supports the cabinet frame and other components.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding storage component made of solid wood, fitted into the cabinet base.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for storing small items and can be pulled out or pushed in for access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along rails or grooves, allowing smooth sliding in and out.

parts.name: Countertop
parts.Basic_description: The countertop is the flat top surface of the cabinet, made of solid wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for placing objects, decorations, or performing tasks.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part attached to the top of the cabinet frame.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal wooden board inside the cabinet used for organizing items.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space of the cabinet into sections for better storage organization.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height depending on the design.
